method: Port of FEATUREFINDER/FeatureFinderAlgorithmPickedHelperStructs.h and .cpp. The 14 START_SECTIONs of the class test are transcribed with their literals and comparison macros. An oracle driver outside this repository replays the same inputs plus 13 boundary cases against the product-SDK libOpenMS; its output is retained here and replayed row for row with floats compared bit for bit.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed differential: product-SDK libOpenMS oracle, 164 rows replayed bit for bit, covering every ported method); tier 3 (transcribed class-test literals and comparison macros, all 14 sections); tier 4 (native ceilings, the NaN-merge error, accessors and default values)

fixtures.role: Output of ../oracle/feature-finder-picked-helper-structs/run.sh, byte-identical across two runs. Rows are case, quantity, kind and value; f64 values are IEEE-754 bit patterns. tests/feature_finder_picked_helper_structs.rs rebuilds every input and requires every row.

class_test_review.literal_extraction: All literals are transcribed verbatim, including the f32 intensity literals with digits beyond f32 precision; the file allows clippy::excessive_precision for that reason. The source test mutates shared state between sections: mt1 is copied into mt after its updateMaximum section, mt2 is pushed after the getPeakCount section, and three border peaks are added to mt[1] before computeIntensityProfile. Each Rust test rebuilds that state in the same order.
class_test_review.comparison: TEST_EQUAL is exact equality after converting the expected value to the actual value's type (ClassTest.h:224-245). TEST_REAL_SIMILAR is isRealSimilar with absdiff_max_allowed 1e-5 and ratio_max_allowed 1 + 1e-5 (ClassTest.cpp:35-38 and 364-470), transcribed in f64; the source evaluates in long double, and the transcribed cases are far from both limits. TEST_EXCEPTION(Exception::Precondition, ...) becomes Err(Error::InvalidValue(_)).

oracle.sdk: product-sdk, Debug build of core 4fdec46b205459b92e7d3b9e56df5d8e912d5c85, AppleClang 21.0.0.21000101, C++23
oracle.revision_equivalence: 4fdec46 is an ancestor of bc9cc12; git diff --stat 4fdec46 bc9cc12 is empty for the helper-struct header and implementation, ConvexHull2D.h/.cpp, Peak1D.h/.cpp, DBoundingBox.h, DIntervalBase.h and DPosition.h.
oracle.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<scratch>/home OPENMS_HOME_PATH=<scratch>/home OPENMS_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=ON OPENMS_DATA_PATH=product-sdk/share/OpenMS/4.0.0, per-run scratch working directory
oracle.reproduction: Two runs from separate scratch directories produced byte-identical output.
oracle.comparison: Exact: every row string equal, so every f64 matches bit for bit. The Rust replay was checked on the Linux x86-64 build node (IBMI kim), with its current stable toolchain and with 1.85.0, with default and with no default features, against the macOS arm64 oracle output.

source_anchors.operation: IsotopePattern(Size): peak(size, -1), four zero vectors, default-initialised theoretical_pattern
getConvexhull: addPoints over (RT, m/z) into a std::map keyed by RT
updateMaximum: strict float >, first maximum wins; empty trace returns early
getAvgMZ: double sums of mz*float and float, then quotient
MassTraces::isValid: fewer than 2 traces false; fabs(seed_mz - avg) <= tolerance
getTheoreticalmaxPosition: Precondition on empty; strict > keeps the first maximum
updateBaseline: 0 when empty; first peak seeds, strict < replaces; untouched when no trace has peaks
getRTBounds: Precondition on empty; starts at (DBL_MAX, -DBL_MAX)
computeIntensityProfile: first trace copied unchecked, later traces merged by a single std::list walk with exact RT equality; double += float
std::sort(seeds.rbegin(), seeds.rend()) is the only use of Seed::operator<
updateBaseline, baseline scaled by 0.75, updateMaximum on traces[max_trace]
input map sorted before run_; afterwards only float data arrays change, never peak m/z or intensity (supports copied TracePeak values)
pattern.peak compared against -2 (removed) and -1 (missing); no other negative value is assigned
duplicate FeatureFinderDefs struct (IndexPair, IndexSet, ChargedIndexSet, Flag, NoSuccessor); unused in source/FEATUREFINDER
IsotopeCluster::IndexSet and ChargedIndexSet typedefs for the legacy Fitter1D family, the other route to IsotopeCluster.h

native_boundaries: MassTrace peaks are (spectrum index, peak index) plus copied rt f64, mz f64 and intensity f32; max_peak is Option<TracePeak>, and pointer identity becomes index equality
Seed exposes is_less_intense_than instead of PartialOrd, because an intensity-only order would contradict the structural PartialEq
IsotopePattern::peak is a PatternPeak enum (NotFound = -1, Removed = -2, Found(index)); the source assigns no other negative value

IsotopePattern::new refuses more than 100,000 isotopes; MassTraces::reserve refuses a capacity above 100,000 traces and maps allocation failure to Error::InvalidValue, leaving the collection unchanged
MassTraces::intensity_profile refuses more than 1,000,000 total peaks or more than 100,000,000 worst-case merge steps before allocating; an index-linked list reproduces the std::list insertion cost

MassTraces::intensity_profile returns Error::InvalidValue where the source loop never terminates (a NaN retention time meeting a profile entry), and an empty profile where the source dereferences begin() of an empty vector
MassTrace::convex_hull refuses non-finite coordinates and more than 1,000,000 peaks
get, get_mut, last and last_mut return Option; Index and IndexMut panic on out-of-range indices like slices
Scalars the source leaves uninitialised (max_rt, theoretical_int, baseline, TheoreticalIsotopePattern scalars) start at zero

not_ported.reason: No includer; duplicates the FeatureFinderDefs struct defined in FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked.h. IndexPair, IndexSet, ChargedIndexSet, Flag and NoSuccessor are not used on the FeatureFinderCentroided path.

Reached only through the two FeatureFinderDefs typedef copies and the legacy Fitter1D.h typedefs; the picked algorithm uses none of them. The coverage ledger's candidate src/processing/deisotoping.rs is an unrelated Deisotoper result struct.

external_reference_note: The oracle driver, its run script and its manifest live outside this repository under ../oracle/feature-finder-picked-helper-structs/ so that no C++ is committed here. The driver links the prebuilt product-SDK libOpenMS (sha256 under oracle); its output is the fixture above, whose sha256 is verified in-repo. The external files are recorded, not re-verified by the in-repo gate, because they are intentionally absent from the crate.
